title: Coverage Aware Active Evaluation for Failure Discovery with Paired Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.13719v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous systems can fail in rare and heterogeneous ways, making real-world failure discovery difficult under limited testing budgets. Although cheaper proxies such as simulators, lower-fidelity systems, or related policies can be sampled extensively to find failures, proxy failures often do not transfer to the real world due to sim-to-real and system-to-system gaps. The key challenge is therefore to effectively leverage proxy system information for accurate prediction of severe target system failures. We propose an adaptive failure discovery method that combines proxy evaluations with limited target system results to guide scenario selection for target system testing. Our method learns a local predictor of target risk by correcting proxy failure signals using control-variate-inspired residual modeling. translated_title: 覆盖感知的主动评估：配对系统中的故障发现
translated_abstract: 自主系统可能以罕见且多样的方式发生故障，这使得在有限测试预算下进行真实世界故障发现变得困难。尽管诸如模拟器、低保真系统或相关策略等更廉价的替代方案可以广泛采样以发现故障，但由于模拟到现实以及系统间的差距，这些替代方案中的故障往往无法转移到真实世界。因此，关键挑战在于有效利用替代系统信息来准确预测严重的目标系统故障。我们提出了一种自适应故障发现方法，该方法结合了替代评估和有限的目标系统结果，以指导目标系统测试的场景选择。我们的方法通过使用控制变量启发的残差建模来校正替代故障信号，从而学习目标风险的局部预测器。为了发现既可能发生又多样化的故障，我们将此预测器与支持感知的互信息目标相结合，该目标有助于...
tldr: 提出一种结合代理评估与有限目标结果的自适应故障发现方法，通过残差建模和覆盖感知目标高效识别目标系统的严重故障。
en_tdlr: We propose an adaptive failure discovery method that leverages proxy evaluations with limited target results, using residual modeling and coverage-aware objectives to efficiently identify severe target system failures.
